acceptance.state: executable: enumerated candidates, real loss/optimizer components
executable: identical pairs per fold, elapsed-time targets, metric oracle
executable: fold-change isolation of scaler, sigma, deltas and pairs; leaky control fails
executable: 1e-6 through arrays, json, terminal and the disposable warehouse
executable: optimizer iterations, events, min_delta 0, float64 floor
executable: deltas from train pairs, full precision, declared fallbacks, 12 per family
executable: both signs, moving-block interval over folds, multiplicity declared
executable: governance before reading, terminal artifacts in the warehouse, tamper detected

reference_evidence.why: no literature reference has been re-executed on this task; no contract of another work is registered

comparability.resolution: a re-execution of a reference method under THIS contract, CLOSED under this digest (MATCHED_DOMAIN_COMPARISON); never a published number from another protocol
comparability.why: no literature reference has been re-executed on this task; no contract of another work is registered

benchmark_contract.metric_aggregation: per horizon, fold, seed and arm; paired by origin
benchmark_contract.metric_formula: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sd_train per horizon and fold; RMSE_z; skill = 1 - MAE_z_model/MAE_z_naive
benchmark_contract.missing_policy: non-finite bars withdrawn; weekend/holiday gaps kept; an origin whose elapsed-time target bar is absent is excluded with reason
benchmark_contract.naive_baseline: persistence: the origin's close, on identical origins
notes: no literature reference bound: NOT_COMPARABLE until a matched re-execution exists
benchmark_contract.permitted_inputs: OHLCV of the served bars (5 channels), window 60
benchmark_contract.scaler_fit_population: train rows of the fold, shared by every arm of the fold
benchmark_contract.split_rule: weekly walk-forward folds (Monday 00:00 UTC .. Sunday 23:00 UTC); DEV = the last 26 weeks before 2025-01-01
benchmark_contract.target_construction: hourly bar close as served; the target of an origin is the bar whose timestamp is origin + h hours ELAPSED (tools/df_fin_task.map_targets); an origin without that exact bar is excluded and counted
benchmark_contract.tuning_budget: equal enumerated candidates per loss family

candidates.budget_per_fit: the recipe's update ceiling and cadence, identical for every candidate; observed updates are recorded per cell
candidates.selection: validation MAE_z of the fold (never the test week); every candidate's test score is retained, no best-test
candidates.trade_off: the Huber family spends its 12 on 2 LR x 3 deltas x {adam, adamw@0.004}; the MAE family on 3 LR x {adam, 3 decays}: equal fit counts and observed budgets, NOT identical LR/decay coverage — declared

delta_rules: Huber deltas in z from the admissible train pairs; every rule is declared and every candidate is finite and > 0.

hosts.blocks: all candidates of a (fold, seed) on one host

compact_modular.head: Dense(p) increment over the last observation; the target channel (close) is read out

receivers.rule: both receivers run every candidate; no candidate is compared across receivers; width, depth and inputs are frozen here

recipe.monitor: validation MAE in scaled units (MAE_z with the fold's train sigma)

reporting.inference: paired by fold (week) between each family's validation-selected candidate; moving-block bootstrap interval; multiplicity = candidates compared per family, declared; no best-test
reporting.precision: predictions and targets saved without rounding; metrics in float64; the float64 floor at the observed MAE_z recorded per cell; min_delta 0
reporting.resolvable: differences down to the float64 floor at ~0.5 (about 1e-16) survive arrays, json and the warehouse; what is DISTINGUISHABLE by inference is bounded by the fold-to-fold spread, reported, not assumed
reporting.scale: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sigma_train per fold, shared by every candidate of the fold; original units secondarily

runner: tools/df_fin_runner.py (prepare / execute / close); acceptance FL01-FL08 on synthetic bars through the disposable stack

availability.declared: a bar's label is the time it is complete (lake contract: event time = available time); the decision at t reads labels <= t only
availability.rule: recorded as limitations; nothing about the producer is invented

folds.dev: the last 26 complete weeks strictly before the reserve
folds.identities: derived at prepare from the delivered bars (tools/df_fin_task.dev_folds), recorded per fold
folds.purge: the horizon in hours between train targets and validation origins, and between validation targets and test origins
folds.scheme: weekly walk-forward by week identity (Monday 00:00 .. Sunday 23:00 on the label's clock)
folds.validation: the week before the test week

h6.mapping: ELAPSED TIME: the bar labelled exactly origin + hours; absent -> excluded with reason (weekend, holiday, missing intraday bar); never the next retained row
h6.why: one quarter of a trading day at this resolution; declared before any score

h72.mapping: ELAPSED TIME: the bar labelled exactly origin + hours; absent -> excluded with reason (weekend, holiday, missing intraday bar); never the next retained row
h72.why: about three days of elapsed time; declared before any score

task.input_window: the last W RETAINED bars ending at the origin (row identity; declared — the window is not an elapsed-time span)
task.missing_policy: non-finite bars withdrawn from pairs; weekend/holiday gaps stay gaps; an origin without its elapsed-time target bar is excluded
task.naive: persistence: the origin's close, on identical pairs

reserve.rule: never read; deliveries are bounded ranges before it

target.transform_for_evaluation: zscore with the fold's train sigma

what_this_is_not: not a run, not a winner, not a trading loss; the household factorial selects nothing financial
